text:
elaine: Quick heads up — planning to cut v2.5.0 in ~6 hours. Can we run a lightweight launchpad CI health pass now? focusing on flaky tests and the version bump PR.

mike: On it. I'll kick a full green sweep but will prioritize failing flakes list. pinging @suresh for the gpu-image bump verification.

suresh: I pulled the image build logs, the new runtime tag failed one integration on tensor-allocator. Reproduced locally:
```
E tensorflow: failed to allocate 2.1GB on /dev/nvidia0
Traceback: AllocError at allocator.cc:93
```
I'm building a debug image now. ETA ~20m.

jen: Version bump PR is ready but changelog needs one more entry for the new batching config. I added a TODO in the changelog file. PR link: https://git.redwood/release/pr/4821

taylor: I can pick up changelog entry. Small note: please keep the rollback notes minimal.

mike: Starting the sweep: ./ci/scripts/launchpad_green_sweep.sh --focus flaky-tests --parallel 6. Will post failures as they appear.

deploy-bot: trigger: launchpad-green-sweep #987 started by mike — queued on runner: ci-kit-05

jen: @elaine should we gate the cut on the image fix? or do we ship with fallback to cpu-only workers for the one affected job?

elaine: Prefer to gate on image fix for Dedicated customers; for hosted we can enable fallback policy but must document perf hit. Let's decide after the sweep results.

ci-ops-bot: flaky-test-alert: test/inference/kv_cache_eviction flaky on linux-x86 — failing 3/10 runs. See artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/987/kv_eviction.log

mike: kv_cache_eviction showing a race in teardown. Quick patch: add small sleep in teardown to avoid flake. I'll open a small PR against main and label it flaky-fix.

suresh: Debug image built; initial integration run passes. Pushed tag: runtime-debug-2026-03-17-01. Recommend we retest the integration job against that tag.

jen: Changelog entry submitted and linked in the version bump PR. Also added a comment on rollout strategy (canary 10% then 100%).

mike: Sweep progress: 68/72 jobs green. Two failing: kv_cache_eviction (infra race) and perf/e2e/large-context which is timing out on the ci runner. Collecting logs.

taylor: For the perf timeout, can we bump the runner timeout to 45m for this job only? We had a similar hit last cycle.

elaine: Yes, go ahead to temporarily extend timeout for that job and note in release notes why. Mike, merge the flaky fix PR and re-run.

mike: flaky PR merged, re-triggering only the failing jobs: ./ci/scripts/retrigger_failed.sh --job-ids 621,622

deploy-bot: retrigger: jobs 621,622 queued — runner: perf-large-03, ci-kit-07

ci-ops-bot: note: remember to tag the release branch with the exact runtime tag used for Dedicated builds. That prevents drift during canary.

elaine: Good catch. We'll pin runtime-debug-2026-03-17-01 for the canary and replace with runtime-2.5.0 after final verification.

mike: All green now. kv_cache_eviction fixed, large-context job passed with extended timeout. Final status: 72/72 green.

elaine: Awesome — final checklist: 1) merge bump PR (jen) 2) tag the branch with runtime-debug-2026-03-17-01 (suresh) 3) push release notes (taylor) 4) kickoff canary (me). If no objections in 30m we cut.

taylor: Taking release notes now. Will post draft in ~10m.

jen: Bump PR merged and changelog updated.

suresh: Tag pushed: refs/tags/v2.5.0-runtime-debug-2026-03-17-01

elaine: Thanks all. I'll start the canary sequence in 20m and report. If anything regresses we abort and roll to fallback. :thumbsup:

mike: Nice job team.

deploy-bot: release-canary: v2.5.0-canary started by elaine — canary group: hosted-small-1 (10%)

elaine: Canary looks healthy at 10%. Proceeding to 50% in 15m unless we see anomalies. Keep an eye on latency/5xx dashboards.

ci-ops-bot: reminder: add the flaky test to the flake rotation board if it reappears after GA.

taylor: Posted release notes draft in #release-notes-drafts with the perf screenshots and rollback instructions.

elaine: Closing the loop here — if no issues in the next hour I'm cutting final and notifying sales/support. Thanks everyone.
